about: The project board. Edit statuses here, or put a trailer line in a commit message: 'Board: E1 done' (statuses: doing, next, blocked, backlog, done); `python tools/dev.py board` applies the trailers and writes handoff/BOARD.md. The prose behind each item is in handoff/BACKLOG.md and docs/.

items.title: EchoFG: the owner's recording of a fast-motion glitch (Saints Row 2, 4K HDR)
items.where: docs/own-generator-plan.md 'Fast motion at a low frame rate'
items.note: 2026-10-11 02:30-02:37: the owner's test left recordings (Videos/Lossless Scaling): 02-32-14 and 02-32-36 are clean 1080p captures of the fast pans (the new eval clips sr2-a, sr2-b); the 4K ones with EchoFG on dropped 80-180 frames (the deployed build predates the recorder crop fix: redeploy). Scores on sr2-a/b: EchoFG 23.9/23.1 dB, FSR 23.6/22.1, blend 19.8/19.2; the worst frames (12-17 dB) are near scene cuts (whip pans of 180-260 px) where nothing works and hold is no better.

items.title: EchoFG: fast motion at a low frame rate: blocky cells on periodic textures, hole fill at big disocclusions
items.note: Both generators break at 3-4x the motion of the test clips (FSR worse). Soften slider exists; the periodic-texture cells are not flagged as doubtful. Look at E1's frames first.

items.title: EchoFG: display timing (the generated frame's present blocks 17-20 ms): vsync / VRR / frame latency
items.note: 2026-10-11 retest (x3 at about 30 fps, 4K 120 Hz, GPU scaling on): the FSR path's generated-frame Present takes 16.7-18.4 ms, EchoFG's 6.4-6.9 ms: the long wait was FSR's. With EchoFG the display shows two presents inside one refresh in about 19% of cases (refresh gaps 0:157 1:460 2:200; FSR path 0:~2) and the presenting thread comes back only 1.6 ms before the next real frame (FSR path 6-7 ms): 90 presents a second on a 120 Hz screen with little slack. Open: is VRR really on (Sync mode Default = interval 0, no tearing flag?), and the slack.

items.title: EchoFG live: x3/x4 spacing, HDR10 (PQ), switching things while it runs
EchoFG discoverability: it lives in the FSR Upscaler's panel, which is off by default and needs NIS scaling: say so in the manager / panel
items.note: The owner could not find the setting on 2026-10-10 (the FSR addon was not switched on).

items.title: EchoFG first-frame 50 ms hitch; further pass merging for cost (4K about 5 ms)
items.note: At 4K the first engine frame costs 0.3-0.4 s on the presenting thread once (1080p: ~90 ms): the first use of the shared frames by the second API (D3D11 Signal / D3D12 hand-over, whichever goes second); touching them on the start-up thread only moved the cost. The slow-frame log line now splits it.
